name: Aboleth
publisher: Tyler Kamstra via Dungeon Masters Guild
heading: Aboleths, Aboleth Traits and Playing an Aboleth
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for the 2014 fifth edition. Official product sample served for product 230312, exact digital revision unmarked.
sourceDistinctions: The preview's 1d6 tentacle strike uses core unarmed strike proficiency. The build treats a grasping tentacle as able to use the pouch and make somatic gestures, since the conversion does not add a no-hands trait.

name: Animated Object
publisher: Tyler Kamstra via Dungeon Masters Guild
heading: Animated Objects and the three subrace traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for the 2014 fifth edition. Official product sample served for product 230312, exact digital revision unmarked.
sourceDistinctions: The official preview gives Flying Sword natural AC 15 + Dexterity modifier. The separately mirrored v2 text gives 17 + Dexterity modifier. The profile follows the official preview. The worked NPC is Animated Armor.

name: Ankheg
publisher: Tyler Kamstra via Dungeon Masters Guild
heading: Ankheg Traits and Playing an Ankheg
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for the 2014 fifth edition. Official product sample served for product 230312, exact digital revision unmarked.
sourceDistinctions: The official preview scales Acid Spray at levels 5, 11, and 17. The separately mirrored v2 text lists levels 6, 11, and 16. The profile follows the official preview. The ordinary Strength damage modifier and Rage bonus apply once to the slashing part of the mixed bite damage.

name: Banshee
publisher: Tyler Kamstra via Dungeon Masters Guild
heading: Banshee Traits and Variant Banshee Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for the 2014 fifth edition. Official product sample served for product 230312, exact digital revision unmarked.
sourceDistinctions: The worked NPC uses flying Banshee and retains Sorrow Bound. A 5-ft. reach for Corrupting Touch is the encounter's reading of the unqualified melee spell attack. Wail uses the legacy Dissonant Whispers spell from the 2014 Player's Handbook, p. 234.
